provenance_rule: Each file is read with git show <commit>:<path>; SHA256 is checked before write. The data worktree HEAD is the source baseline, while this manifest records every overlay. Runtime code is a separate worktree at runtime_revision.
limitations: This is a materialization/provenance fixture, not a runtime execution receipt.
The historical S2 r4 public summary is derived/redacted and cannot stand in for the missing verbatim operation receipt.
Prepared candidate identity includes data root and actual HEAD; record each run identity rather than expecting the historical candidate ID.
Reference commits are externally verified by git object reads and exact hashes; prepare itself labels this external-capture-evidence-required.
